structured_output.what_is_happening: A Pump.fun token about 35 minutes old, "musejak", graduated to PumpSwap and ran about +300–390% within its first hour, reaching an all-time-high market cap of about $307k. It is now around $230–243k, and the last 5 minutes are down 13–21%. Volume in the first hour was about $1.8M against about $46k of liquidity and about $230k market cap, so hourly turnover was about 39x. Buys and sells are almost equal in count (about 6.1k vs 5.8k), and there were about 1,350 unique buyers and 1,190 unique sellers. GMGN flags 153 bundler wallets, 47 snipers and 62 rat/insider wallets. It counts 818 fresh wallets among 838 holders, a fresh-wallet rate of 57%. GeckoTerminal/structure data shows 64 graph-detected insiders in four 16-wallet transfer networks. The packet shows no paid DexScreener boosts or ads, but the DexScreener profile was updated. At least three same-name copycat tokens appeared within about 25 minutes, and one of them already had about $606k of volume in its first hour.

narrative.description: A generic cute-character meme. The "-jak" suffix borrows from the wojak/soyjak meme family, and the "muse" is a soft, glowing figure. The description is only vibes ("no heroic pose... wondering what everyone is so worked up about"). Nothing points to a news hook, a celebrity, a cultural event or an existing community. It looks like a manufactured launch with a website and an X account ready at launch.
narrative.why_spreading: The spread seems driven by trading mechanics rather than any story: a fast graduation, high-churn volume, bundled and fresh wallets, and trenches bots picking up the chart. Copycats appearing quickly show that traders are chasing the ticker, not a meme with cultural pull. The packet has no evidence of organic social discussion.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN counts 153 bundler wallets, and the top bundlers hold about 19% of traded share. It also flags 47 snipers and 62 rat traders. Four 16-wallet transfer networks make up 64 graph insiders. 818 of 838 holders are fresh wallets. Turnover of 39x with nearly equal buy and sell counts suggests heavy wash/bot churn. The launch came fully packaged (site, X account, updated DexScreener profile), and the dev's X account has launched 2 tokens. There are no smart-money signals, no KOL/renowned wallets, and only 46 GMGN page visits.
authenticity.uncertainty: No X data. Unique buyer counts above 1,300 suggest some real retail participation. The creator holds only 0.24%, and top-10 concentration is moderate at about 15–25%, so the classic dev-dump risk is lower. Bundler and fresh-wallet tags on GMGN can be noisy for new tokens.

153 bundler wallets and 64 insiders in transfer networks can exit in a coordinated way
The price is already down 13–21% over 5 minutes, off an all-time high of about $307k

If the X account posts well-received art, a second leg above the all-time high is plausible within 6 hours.
